info.title: XAF Logic Explainer — Model Context Protocol server
info.description: Model Context Protocol server for DevExpress XAF applications. Exposes an application's entities, controllers, actions, business rules and Model Editor customizations as MCP tools, so an agent can query a specific XAF codebase instead of guessing about it. Reads source with Roslyn; no DevExpress licence required.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Answers questions about a specific DevExpress XAF application by reading its source.
